title: Discharge of sewage and discharge and/or management of stormwater runoff.
officialText:
Applications for construction document approval shall comply with Sections 106.6.1, 106.6.2 and 106.6.3.
*Section 106.6 was amended by Local Law 97 of 2017. This law has an effective date of June 1, 2019.
